items.title: 3 AI Investment Stocks We’re Buying Today And Why We’re Selling On Micron
items.summary: With AI infrastructure stocks pulling back 30% to 80% from their highs, many investors are making adjustments to their portfolio. Eric Bleeker, the co-host of The AI Investor Podcast, recently shared three AI-related stocks he's buying as we head into 2027, as well as why he is selling on Micron. Among his recommendations is  Analog Devices, a longtime industry winner with a comprehensive portfolio in sensing, precision motion, and power management that stands to capture thousands of dollars in hardware content per humanoid robot.
